probes.name: unchanged
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, code As Object
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set code = target.VBProject.VBComponents("Sheet1").CodeModule
code.AddFromString "Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)" & vbCrLf & "Application.EnableEvents = False" & vbCrLf & "Range(""B1"").Value = 1" & vbCrLf & "Application.EnableEvents = True" & vbCrLf & "End Sub"
Application.EnableEvents = True
target.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 5
Application.EnableEvents = False
target.Worksheets(1).Range("B1").ClearContents
Application.EnableEvents = True
target.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 7
Probe = CStr(target.Worksheets(1).Range("B1").Value)
Application.EnableEvents = False
target.Close False
Application.EnableEvents = True
End Function
